title: Multi-Group Scalping EA — Fair Value Gap mean-reversion entry with hedge-after-10 + ATR trailing stop
entry_long: bullish FVG detected (candle ID1 low > candle ID3 high, body ID2 bullish >=100 pips, drawn as lines FVG_B1/B2); price closes back inside the gap; EMA3>EMA8>EMA200 uptrend confirm -> buy min lot
entry_short: mirror: bearish FVG (ID1 high < ID3 low, body ID2 bearish >=100 pips) drawn as FVG_S1/S2; price closes back inside gap; EMA3<EMA8<EMA200 downtrend confirm -> sell min lot
exit: trailing stop distance scaled by ATR(average-to-range) once >=2 orders open; no fixed SL/TP; martingale-recovery leg closes all at $3 profit
escalation_cap: martingale caps at 10 orders then switches to a hedge order (opposite side) every 100 pips; lot +0.01 every 5-order step; separate 30% of balance cut-loss switch closes everything
buildon_idea: already capped (10-order hedge trigger + optional 30% balance cut-loss); flat-lot test the FVG+EMA entry alone before trusting the martingale-amplified numbers; try linear-add lot law instead of step-martingale
novelty_note: FVG zone entry + EMA trend filter + built-in hedge-after-10 recovery layer is a fairly complete self-contained recovery system; moderate novelty

exit: no SL/TP stated on entries; martingale recovery leg closes when profit target reached (order-count based cut only)

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA — Breakout Fair Value Gap with RSI filter + hedge-after-10 + 30% cut-loss
entry_long: 3-candle bullish FVG detected; RSI(7) oversold(<30); price breaks/closes above the opposite sell-gap (FVG_S2) -> buy (breakout, not mean-reversion)
entry_short: 3-candle bearish FVG detected; RSI(7) overbought(>70); price breaks/closes below buy-gap (FVG_B2) -> sell
exit: trailing stop scaled by ATR once >=2 orders open; martingale-recovery leg closes at $3 profit; hedge order opens every 100 pips once 10 orders reached
escalation_cap: 10 orders before hedge mode triggers (opposite-side order every 100 pips); 30% of balance cut-loss closes everything; lot +0.01 every 5-order step
buildon_idea: already capped via hedge@10 + 30% balance cut-loss; author reports only ~11% drawdown vs 2025 gains on 6mo/6000+ trade sample — flat-lot test the RSI+breakout entry alone to isolate real edge from martingale amplification
novelty_note: inverts EX196's mean-reversion-in-gap logic to a breakout-of-gap entry; same recovery/hedge chassis reused across the series

entry_short: mirror: sell if price breaks below buy-gap FVG_B2 with RSI overbought, OR price closes back inside sell-gap FVG_S1/S2
exit: trailing stop scaled by ATR once >=2 orders; martingale-recovery leg closes at $3 profit; hedge order every 100 pips after 10 orders
escalation_cap: 10 orders before hedge mode; 30% balance cut-loss closes everything; lot +0.01 every 5-order step
buildon_idea: already capped (hedge@10 + 30% cut-loss); combining both EX196+EX197 entry conditions roughly doubled trade count per author — flat-lot A/B each condition separately to see which one (if either) carries the edge

title: Multi-Group Scalping EA — Fibonacci 61.8% retracement + RSI + EMA trend filter, martingale with growing step distance
entry_long: EMA3>EMA200 uptrend, EMA3 crosses below EMA8 (pullback) triggers auto Fib draw; price retraces past level 4 (61.8%) then crosses back up through it with a bullish reversal candle pattern + RSI oversold -> buy
entry_short: mirror: EMA3<EMA200 downtrend pullback triggers Fib draw; price crosses back down through 61.8% with bearish reversal candle + RSI overbought -> sell
exit: trailing stop scaled by ATR once >=2 orders open; martingale-recovery leg closes when profit exceeds a growing close_money formula (scales with order count, prevents premature negative-close)
escalation_cap: hard cap 15 orders per group (close-all regardless of P&L); lot +0.01 every 5-order step, martingale step-distance also doubles each reset
buildon_idea: capped at 15 orders (order-count only, no explicit %-balance cut-loss shown); flat-lot test the Fib 61.8%+RSI+candle-confirm entry alone before trusting the reported ~99% 2025 backtest return; add a hard %-balance cut-loss layer
novelty_note: auto-generated 7-level Fibonacci object driven off EMA-pullback trigger, but only the 61.8% level is actually used for entries — the other 6 levels are taught but unused, an extension seam for the student

entry_short: EMA_fast(3)<EMA200 downtrend, RSI(7) overbought(>70), price crosses back down through Fib level 61.8% with bearish reversal candle confirm -> sell

title: Scalping EA — Impulse (Time Bomb) detection + bullish/bearish engulfing confirm, martingale capped 50 orders

entry_short: Time Bomb Down block detects a 30-pip drop within 10 seconds AND bearish engulfing pattern -> sell
exit: trailing stop scaled by ATR once >=2 orders open; martingale-recovery leg closes at a growing close_money target scaled by order count; no fixed SL/TP
escalation_cap: hard cap 50 orders (Max Order) stops the recovery leg to prevent account blowup; lot +0.01 every 5-order step
buildon_idea: capped at 50 orders (order-count only, no %-balance cut-loss shown); flat-lot test the impulse+engulfing entry alone before trusting the martingale-amplified backtest; the built-in Time Bomb block is reusable as a standalone impulse/breakout trigger independent of the martingale chassis
novelty_note: uses FX-DMA's prebuilt impulse-detection block (Time Bomb) rather than manual candle-range math — reusable trigger primitive worth cataloging separately

title: EMA crossover EA with monthly/daily profit-target lockout + server-time filter + capped Martingale money management
entry_long: EMA5>EMA200 uptrend, EMA5 crosses above EMA10, and current price within 200 pips of EMA5 -> buy using FX-DMA built-in Martingale money-management (x2 lot on loss, resets to base on win), SL/TP 500 pips each; only fires while month-to-date and day-to-date profit targets are unmet and within a 14:00-21:00 server-time window
entry_short: mirror: EMA5<EMA200 downtrend, EMA5 crosses below EMA10, price within 200 pips of EMA5 -> sell, same martingale/SL/TP/time-filter rules
exit: fixed SL 500 pips / TP 500 pips per order; martingale multiplier resets to base lot (0.01) on a win
escalation_cap: capped at 5.0 lots (Volume Upper Limit) with x2 multiplier on loss; has hard SL/TP unlike other cards in this batch
buildon_idea: already capped (5-lot ceiling + hard 500-pip SL, unlike the uncapped/no-SL FVG and impulse EAs in this batch) — solid base to build on directly; the monthly(3%)/daily(0.1%) profit-lockout + server-time-window wrapper is a reusable risk-management module worth extracting into EDGE_CATALOG independent of the generic EMA entry it's demonstrated on
novelty_note: the profit-lockout module (halts trading once monthly or daily profit target hit, tracked via daily/monthly balance snapshots) is the genuinely reusable/novel part; the EMA5/10/200 entry itself is generic and low-novelty
